paite: Huan Joseph inkuanpihte lak a mi, Manasseh tapa Makir tapa Gilead tate inkuan lupente lak a mite'n ahon naih ua, Mosi leh heutu, Israel suante intekpente ma ah thu agen uhi.
heading: Pasal Nei Numeite Goutan
english: The heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near and spoke before Moses and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel.

paite: "TOUPA'N ka toupa Israel suante aisan a, aluah ding uh gam pe ding in thu apia hi. TOUPA'N ka toupa, ka unaupa uh Jelophehad gam a tanute pe ding in nang thu ahon pia hi.
english: They said, “Yahweh commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel. My lord was commanded by Yahweh to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.

paite: Amau Israel suante lak a mi, namdang kuapeuh tate ava kitenpih uleh, ka pi-le-pute uh gam aluah uh laksak a, akitenpih uh namte gam toh gawm ding ahi dia; huchibang in ka gam tantuan ua kipan lakkhiak ahi ding hi.
english: If they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So it will be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.

paite: Israel suante Jubili ahong tun chiang in agam uh ava kitenpih uh namte gam toh gawm ding ahi dia; huchi in ka pi-le-pute uh gam a pan amau gam lak hek ahong hi ding hi," achi uh.
english: When the jubilee of the children of Israel comes, then their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.”

paite: Mosi in, TOUPA thu bang in Israel suante thu apia a, "Joseph tate nam in agen dik uhi.
english: Moses commanded the children of Israel according to Yahweh’s word, saying, “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speak what is right.

paite: Jelophehad tanute tungtang thu a TOUPA'N thu apiak pen hiai ahi. 'Hoih asaksak uh kitenpih uhenla, himahleh apate uh nampih lak a mi ngei akitenpih ding uh ahi.
english: This is the thing which Yahweh commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, ‘Let them be married to whom they think best, only they shall marry into the family of the tribe of their father.

paite: Huchi in Israel suante gam pen namdang kiang a suan ahi kei ding. Israel suante'n api-le-pute uh nam gam aneih gige ding uh ahi.
english: So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel move from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall all keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

paite: Israel suante lak a gouluah ding tanu peuhmah Israel suante'n api-le-pute uh gam aluah chiat zel theihna ding un apa nampih lak a mi zi ahih ngeingei ding ahi.
english: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel shall be wife to one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may each possess the inheritance of his fathers.

paite: Huchi in gam bel namdang kiang a suan ahi kei ding hi. Israel suante'n amau gam chiat atang gige ding uh ahi ngal a, " achi hi.
english: So shall no inheritance move from one tribe to another tribe; for the tribes of the children of Israel shall each keep his own inheritance.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in Jelophehad tanute'n ahih uhi.
english: The daughters of Zelophehad did as Yahweh commanded Moses:

paite: Jelophehad tanu Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milkah leh Noahte'n apa uh unau tapate akitenpih uhi.
english: for Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to their father’s brothers’ sons.

paite: Joseph tapa Manasseh tapate akitenpih ua, agam uh apa uh nam ah a-om gige hi.
english: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph. Their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

paite: Hiaite TOUPA'N Mosi zang a Jeriko zawn Jordan gal a Moab Phaizang a Israel suante apiak, thupiakte leh vaihawmdante ahi uhi.
english: These are the commandments and the ordinances which Yahweh commanded by Moses to the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
